mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate increase above 0.3% (measured from CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in private employment (PAYEMS) and fall in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annually and CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.2%), a CPIAUCSL value above 240 signals overheating and imminent policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5% AND CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where the late-cycle expansion condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST shows a rising trend, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production increase above 1.0% (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO monthly change > 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (defined by PAYEMS exceeding 145,000 and UNRATE below 5.0%), a low unemployment rate signals potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 145000 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
